name: functional-style
title: Functional style
summary: Four rules enforcing one house style: no classes, no `this`, no inheritance, no default exports.
description: This tier encodes a decision, not a defect. There is nothing wrong with a class — these rules exist because some projects have chosen records plus free functions and want the choice enforced rather than restated in review. The default-export rule rides along for the same reason: named exports keep an identity that is stable across files, which is what makes a codebase searchable.
adopt_when: Your project has actually made this call and says so somewhere — a CLAUDE.md, a constraints doc, a taste doc. Enforcing a style nobody agreed to is how a rule gets suppressed everywhere instead of followed.
decline_when: You use classes, you use a framework that requires default exports, or the question has simply never come up. Decline now and adopt later; nothing else in this plugin depends on it.
